properties.description:
THE FIRST RELEASE THAT REMOVES A NODE TYPE. Node types 29 to 28; edge types unchanged at 65. Every prior stamp move was additive and left an existing graph readable untouched, so this is the first cut whose upgrade action is REQUIRED rather than "none" — and it is required of EVERY consumer, because the guard reads a graph's stamp rather than its contents and every graph in existence names QualityGate whether or not it ever held one. docs/upgrading-to-v0.55.0.md carries the migration, which was run end to end on this project's own graph before shipping: 3,989 nodes and 21,555 edges in, the same out, nothing lost.

THE ENVIRONMENT COMPLIANCE LAYER, built as a whole leg on Anthony's ruling after its parking's own stated reversal condition was met. Six typed tools (add_environment_rule, operates_in, imposes, complies_with, violates_rule, set_violation_status), four edges, and two detectors that ask a person rather than repairing anything: unchecked_compliance for a mandatory rule the design has said nothing about, open_violation for a flagged violation nobody has triaged. Three kinds of rule now stay apart — a Constraint the design imposes on itself, a DesignRule it chose as a convention, and an EnvironmentRule the world imposes on it, which it may comply with, seek a variance from, or fail, but cannot simply drop.

RE-LINKING AN ARTIFACT NO LONGER RENAMES IT. link_artifact wrote the name unconditionally while every field beside it preserved on omission, and because the surface made name mandatory, "leave the name alone" could not be said. The name in effect is now resolved from the stored value; description is accepted here too.

QualityGate IS RETIRED. It modelled the stage gate — a dated, waivable judgement at a phase boundary, and never a duplicate of Verification, since a test does not get waived. It went unused for structural reasons: it participated in no edge type at all, its criteria was a JSON array inside a string nothing could read, and decisively nothing in the design ever carried a phase, so the gate had nothing to gate. Its conditions are computed continuously by detect_gaps and detect_defects instead. The decision records the condition under which it should return.

THE THROUGH-LINE OF THE INCREMENT'S FIXES IS ONE DEFECT CLASS, found four more times in a single day: A LIST MAINTAINED BY HAND WITH NOTHING CHECKING THAT ITS ENTRIES ARE STILL TRUE. The preserve-on-revise guard drew its membership from `add_*` call names rather than from the behaviour it polices; the constructor sweep's exemption list had three dead entries of four; and the schema-size claims in four documents were unchecked, with the edge count wrong for weeks. Each now checks its own entries; guarded doc claims went 3 to 11.
properties.name: v0.55.0 — a design can say what the world imposes on it, and one type that never earned its place leaves the schema
